notes: `מִקֶּדֶם` is split rather than fused under rule 40: the ASV writes *of* for the preposition and *old* for the noun, so each morpheme holds a rendering of its own.
`כָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ` writes no *of*, so the quantifying construct keeps only *all* and the rectum only its own word (rule 19).

The two supplied *the*s go to the nouns that license them — rule 15 for *the days*, rule 29 for the construct *the work*, no article morpheme standing in either phrase. Nothing is added or unrepresented.
